test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: M is married to N. N is the daughter of U. U is married to S. S is sister of P. P is the son of Q. R is mother of S. How is N related to Q?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfac61035decb70b5bbb772c6d93a121349214bb0120276e9e937644d95aaf70.png] 

As per the given information:

1. M is married to N and N is the daughter of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afbbe4d232a2d69491220fb4c16894f9923b6c892de079fedcab39d152d58b22.png] 

2. U is married to S and S is the sister of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d63062090f0da08fd162d7e8c28920889777e5e11f0faf7fa0ec88467deb9a1c.png] 

3. P is the son of Q and R is the mother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddfa1ec16093628e7b9c4ec2b026ed401f2a9b759988bc273482a441b545925d.png] 

Here, N is the daughter's daughter of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
